name: scene3d_set_actor_appearance
description: Restyle placed people. `appearance`: human (default figure), mannequin (neutral articulated figure), character (a library character, `characterId` from library_list type=character, which must already carry a 3D model). `color` (#RRGGBB) tints human/mannequin figures only — a character wears its own textures. Batch every actor in one call. Identity, transform, pose and Motion tracks are untouched: an existing performance keeps playing and stays regenerable on any figure. @see guides_get('scene3d')

actors.description: Batch every actor in ONE call. Shape: [{ "id": "agent-…", "appearance": "mannequin", "color": "#5B8DEF" }].

appearance.description: human | mannequin | character. Default to human unless the user asked for another figure.

characterId.description: Numeric library character id (library_list type=character). Required for appearance character, ignored otherwise.

color.description: Hex #RRGGBB tint for a human/mannequin figure. Omit to keep the current one.
